slides.texte_overlay:
the 1% habits that make
a huge difference by 30

one page a day

read just one page of a book every single day. it sounds tiny, but most days one page turns into ten, and by thirty you'll have read hundreds of books.

a glass of water first

drink a glass of water before anything else each morning. it's the smallest habit there is, and it quietly improves your energy, skin and focus over the years.

a five minute tidy

tidy up for five minutes before bed every single night. waking up to a calm space every day for ten years changes how your whole life feels from the inside.

one small lesson

learn one small thing every day in 5 minutes: a word, a painting, a moment in history. ten years of tiny lessons builds a mind most people only dream of having.

a daily walk

walk for twenty minutes every day, rain or shine. the health, clarity and calm it builds over a decade are worth more than almost any other habit you could start.
